name: Truncate
goal: Add `truncate(text, max)` in a new file, src/truncate.mjs: it returns `text` unchanged when it has at most `max` characters, and otherwise cuts it and ends it with "…" (one character) so that the result is exactly `max` characters long. A `text` that is not a string throws a TypeError, and a `max` that is not a positive integer throws a RangeError. Tests go in tests/truncate.test.mjs. Done when every item in docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md is shown to hold, `npm test` passes, and a human approves the merge.
description: A builder implements the task. A critic in a fresh context checks the diff and test output against a written checklist; failures return to the builder with REVIEW.md, and a pass goes to a human merge gate, whose rejection also returns to the builder. The loop stops when the bar passes, at its round cap, or at its turn budget. Builder and critic share a tier, which the validator flags; heterogeneous-critic is the same shape with the critic on another tier.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Do the task in the code, with tests. On a later round, read REVIEW.md first and address each finding, or say why it does not apply. Run the test command before you report, and do not review your own work beyond that.
outputs: CHANGES.md: what changed this round and which findings it addresses

nodes.name: Critic
nodes.brief: Judge the change against the checklist, one line per item, citing the file and line that satisfies it or saying it is unmet; use the repository only to understand what the change touches. Run the test command yourself rather than trusting a report; you judge, you do not fix. Verdict pass only when every item holds and the tests pass; invalid-evidence when the diff or checklist cannot be read.
inputs: the repository at the head commit, read-only
outputs: REVIEW.md: one line per checklist item and a verdict line

nodes.name: Merge approval
nodes.prompt: The critic passed the change against the checklist. Merge it?

evidence: the repository at the head commit, read-only

bar.name: Review checklist
bar.acceptance: Every checklist item is cited as satisfied with a file and line, and `npm test` exits 0.
